name: Nations Roleplay : Remastered
desc:
A fast-paced war game that brings back the classic Nations Roleplay as a real-time strategy game, with armies on the map instead of Paint Buckets.

Create your own country, develop its economy, and lead it through war. Command ground, naval, and air units, capture provinces, and expand your borders. Form powerful alliances, use diplomacy, or conquer rival nations. Expand across the map or help your allies hold their ground. Missiles and nukes can turn a war around in minutes.

💾 Private servers support saving and loading custom maps.
🏆Reach 150,000 XP to unlock Competitive XP Servers.

👥Join the Nations Roleplay Community for codes, updates, and events:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/8895838/Nations-Roleplay-Community#!/about
